item.title: PortWin 1.39
item.description:
• New Library: every game and program from all your bottles in one grid with covers. Steam and GOG games get their official art; you can drop your own image on a card or use “Find Cover…”. Recently played games and play time are shown, and a single click launches a game.
  • Installed programs now appear by themselves in your Mac’s Applications folder, Launchpad and Spotlight, like any Mac app (can be turned off in Settings).
  • Frame rate counter: turn on the Metal HUD for any game in its settings or from the Library menu.
  • “Works?” reports: after a game has run for a minute, you can tell other users whether it works. Reports feed the public list at portwin.kuka-soft.com/games. Nothing is sent unless you click.
  • Games from the Xbox app and PC Game Pass are recognized: PortWin explains why they can’t run in Wine and offers the Steam version or Xbox Cloud Gaming instead.
  • Fix Automatically tries Wine 11 early for 32-bit DirectX 8–9 games.
